view_definitions.sql: CREATE VIEW observations AS SELECT row_id, keyword_id, score FROM read_parquet('/pyg-vepfs/public/lyl/openalex_energy_fetch/energy-topic-identification/work/full_nmf500_20260926/keyword_parts/*.parquet');

CREATE VIEW papers AS SELECT row_id, doc_id, date, "language", title_only, retracted, template_record, usable FROM read_parquet('/pyg-vepfs/public/lyl/openalex_energy_fetch/jjjj/bertopic500_all_sources_20260925/data/corpus/*.parquet') WHERE ("source" = 'paper');
